messages:
marta: Heads up — checksum mismatch found on the offline-installer bundle for v1.12.4 during final packaging.
priya: where's the mismatch? log?
marta: the artifact at s3://redwood-packaging/offline/v1.12.4/bundle.tar.gz sha256 != signed-manifest. Quick diff:
```
sha256sum bundle.tar.gz -> e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924
manifest expected            -> a1f9d7c4b3e2d6f88a9a4c3e6f1a2b07
```
jason: did cosign verify pass?
priya: cosign verify returned OK for signature but the digest differs; suspect post-signing compression step
santiago: @deploy-bot can you show last packaging step run id?
deploy-bot: Packaging run id=prg-20260320-2211, status=SUCCEEDED
deploy-bot: steps: pull-src -> build -> package -> gzip -> cosign-sign
lisa: if signed manifest points at compressed blob, check content-encoding transform and gzip flags
marta: reproducing locally now. If we need a rollback we should pin previous sealed bundle v1.12.3 as fallback
priya: can we retag without re-signing? no — cosign embeds digest, so retag won't change digest
jason: timeline: we have a 02:00 UTC delivery window. Can we repackage and resign in ~90m?
santiago: @marta try `gzip -1` variant; CI image might default to -9 and that changes digest
marta: running local reproduce: `gzip -9 bundle.tar` produced digest that matches manifest exactly
priya: so CI used -9 and our local earlier used -1 — mismatch explained
marta: rebuilding with -9 and re-running cosign...
priya: new bundle built and cosign signed, signature OK
priya: new digest -> a1f9d7c4b3e2d6f88a9a4c3e6f1a2b07 (matches manifest)
deploy-bot: staging push for v1.12.4-resign1 -> COMPLETE (s3://staging/offline/v1.12.4-resign1)
ops-bot: holding canary for 30m per playbook. Monitoring hooks enabled: checksum, cosign-verify, smoke-e2e
lisa: adding note to packager Dockerfile to pin gzip version and set explicit gzip flags
santiago: can we avoid re-hitting KMS repeatedly? cosign re-signing uses same key material, allowed per KMS policy until daily quota reached
priya: rolling forward with tag v1.12.4-resign1. Canary window starts 02:15 UTC (15m buffer after staging push)
marta: approved — release notes draft: "offline installer: fixed packaging compression mismatch; rebuilt and resigned bundle (v1.12.4-resign1)"
jason: ack. scheduling fanout if no alerts during canary (30m).
marta: important: if any checksum alert triggers during fanout, immediate abort and rollback to v1.12.3, notify customers & partners
santiago: acknowledged — prepped rollback playbook and signed manifest for v1.12.3 available
priya: I'll post an FYI to #partners and the vendor SFTP ops channel with ETA and signed checksum
deploy-bot: roll policy: allow-resign -> push -> canary (30m) -> controlled fanout -> final-promote
marta: logged action item: enforce gzip flags in CI & add a packager unit test for deterministic compression
lisa: will open a PR to Dockerfile and CI tomorrow morning
jason: thanks team, good catch. :thumbsup:
marta: closing this thread after fanout completes without alerts. Will open a short incident postmortem if we see recurring mismatches.
priya: thanks — updating release checklist and delivery tracker now.
